title: Fix API auth NEXT_REDIRECT to return 401
description: requireAuth() uses redirect() which throws NEXT_REDIRECT in API route context. Unauthenticated calls to /api/accessibility, /api/signals, /api/system/health return 500 {"error":"NEXT_REDIRECT"} instead of 401. Make requireAuth API-aware.

classification.rationale: Classified as SIMPLE complexity. Direct delegation: single domain, no cross-cutting impact. Required agents (4): backend, frontend, qa, memory_engineer.
